en.title: Environmental Protection Agency: 55 references to U.S. Code sections repealed, omitted or not in the Code
en.summary: In the CFR chapters assigned to the Environmental Protection Agency, 55 references in 50 sections cite a U.S. Code section that release point 119-134 of the U.S. Code does not carry in force: 35 cite a number the Code does not have; 13 cite a section omitted from the Code; 7 cite a repealed section. The release names no successor for these sections.
en.impact: A reader who follows these references does not reach the text the rule relies on. No effect on a decision or an amount has been established.
en.correction: The agency decides whether to remove or replace each reference. The U.S. Code names no successor for these sections.

Omitted Editorial Notes Codification Sections 300v to 300v-3, which provided for the establishment, duties, administration, funding, and termination of the President's Commission for the Study of Ethical Problems in Medicine and Biomedical and Behavioral Research, were omitted pursuant to section 300v-3, which provided for the Commission's termination on Dec. 31, 1982.
